objective_contribution: Resolve the incomplete one-shot state signal on GLM-5.3-flash at 8K under the fixed ContextBench criteria while counting every model input and output token.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does the promising one-shot boundary-state signal replicate over all eight GLM-5.3-flash 8K pairs after a common provider-deadline repair?

measurement_mapping.native: All eight paired native ContextBench span and file metrics measure evidence-selection usefulness; native selection does not prove patch correctness.
measurement_mapping.retention: Exactly one receipt-bound presentation in every recycled treatment generation establishes exposure; native improvement is required for useful-retention support.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Check state facts, presentation generation, dispatched request, source credit, correction, usage receipt, arm parity, and terminal effects independently.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative model input and output tokens for every successful, failed, corrective, recovery, state, and terminal request; unknown usage invalidates the experiment decision.
measurement_mapping.transfer: One exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K replication cannot establish larger windows, other models, other domains, repair correctness, semantic retention, untouched confirmation, or clearance.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before 10K/12K, larger windows, or other models.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through ten and these eight development identities are exposed; reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, replacement, source refresh, prompt/cap/threshold/state change, or lucky rerun. Retain all outcomes and pause on shared failure.

retained_counterevidence: Round four recovery had negligible native gain, file regression, and 77,656 extra model tokens.
Round nine complete-pair state span F1 was 0.0655 lower, with 86,838 more state-arm tokens and 52 repeated presentations.
Round ten removed every repeated presentation and showed +0.2288 descriptive complete-pair span gain with 57,576 fewer known state-arm tokens, but only three pairs completed.
Round ten state restored a valid score on task three and lost one on task four, leaving aggregate valid scored completions tied.
A 120-second GLM deadline produced one unknown-usage receipt and paused three cells; the partial signal is not decision eligible.
Output-cap correction remains live-unexposed, and semantic evidence interpretation remains a competing limitation.
successor_rule: Freeze H21 only after common deadline tests, matched design, tokenizer-only preflight, exact source closure, and freeze continuity pass. Run each round-eleven cell once. A complete miss selects a reviewed H20/H0 or new competing successor; a complete pass may prepare untouched confirmation but never changes acceptance or claims clearance.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The plan targets reusable reasoning continuity, recovery, correctness-oriented outcomes, completion, and cumulative model token efficiency.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: The plan keeps GLM-5.3-flash qualification and the small-window-first order explicit.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench contract remains uncleared; this exposed replication cannot clear it.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: The ontology chain starts from the reviewed round-ten incomplete result and proceeds through competing H21/H20/H0, experiment, observation, decision, and successor.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Prior quality, token, recycling, validity, exposure, output-recovery, and provider failures remain explicit constraints.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, retention exposure, integrity, correctness limits, and every model input/output token remain distinct.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The exposed 8K cohort stays separate from untouched confirmation, larger windows, SWE-bench, other models, and other domains.
criterion_verdicts.testability: H21 fixes eight complete pairs, native and validity gates, token ceiling, per-generation exposure, integrity checks, common deadline, and stopping rules.
